site.name: Bloom & Budget
site.description: A warm, no-shame blog about budgeting your first salary, dodging fresh-grad money mistakes, and adulting like you actually know what you're doing.
site.audience: young women starting their first job in the United States
site.audienceShort: young women starting their first job

author.name: Emma Jane
author.bio: Emma Jane writes Bloom & Budget for young women in their first job, the year when a salary finally lands and nobody explains what to do with it. She believes a budget is a permission slip, not a punishment, and that most money advice fails because it talks down to people. Everything here is written to be used tonight, not admired.
